title: Expand no-fallback lint to catch .get(key, [])
description: Follow-up to the .get(key, {}) check added in PR #1206. Add .get(key, []) detection to lint_no_fallback.py — empty list defaults hiding missing keys. There are ~192 existing violations across the codebase. Each must be individually reviewed and rewritten: use direct key access when the field is required, or an explicit presence check when it is genuinely optional. Do this incrementally in small reviewable PRs.
